description: Use this when someone asks where the Moon is right now or today: its sign (Vedic and Western), its nakshatra, its phase, or when the next full moon or new moon comes ("what sign is the Moon in today", "moon phase today", "next full moon", "today’s nakshatra"). Needs no birth details and no place. Do not use for a person’s own Moon sign at birth: use moon_sign_nakshatra for that.
name: moon_today
title: The Moon today
